project.title: Agriculture Canada - Cloud Centre of Expertise / Cloud Operations

role_overview.summary: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada's (AAFC) Cloud Centre of Expertise (CCoE) is mandated to deliver a secure, scalable, and governable public cloud environment to support departmental business users and analytics workloads. Christian served as AWS Cloud DevOps Architect on a part-time basis across two concurrent tracks — the Cloud Operations platform team responsible for the managed AWS Landing Zone environment and full ATO achievement, and the Analytics team responsible for cloud-native application development and DevSecOps pipeline delivery. The engagement spanned 32 months, delivering ITSG-22/33/38-aligned compliance tooling, Azure AD SSO federation, and a comprehensive DevSecOps pipeline with automated code and IaC security scanning.

challenge.summary: The AAFC Cloud Centre of Expertise (CCoE) are focused on providing a secure and scalable managed public cloud environment to internal business users. The AWS Cloud environment is implemented using standard AWS Landing Zone foundations with layers of Infrastructure as Code governance resources deployed to meet both Operational and Security requirements, as well as achieve full ATO status for production workloads.

solution.summary: Delivered comprehensive cloud and infrastructure solutions across:
deliverables: Cloud Centre of Expertise / Cloud Operations

outcomes: ✅ Achieved full ATO (Authority to Operate) status for Agriculture Canada's AWS Cloud environment, meeting ITSG-22/33/38 requirements

✅ Successfully implemented automated security and governance compliance tooling that exceeded GoC cloud guardrails, enabling secure cloud adoption across the department with integrated Azure AD SSO federation
✅ Delivered critical analytics platform supporting analytics operations through AWS cloud-native architecture for client workload systems
✅ Implemented comprehensive DevSecOps pipeline with automated security scanning and supply chain management, enabling secure data analysis capabilities
